latin: Qui sciuerit explicare quaternariumin denarium habebit modum, si sit peritus Cabalae, deducendi ex nomine ineffabili nomen .1xxii. litterarum.

translation: He who knows how to unfold the four within the ten will have, if skilled in Kabbalah, the method of deducing from the ineffable Name the Name of seventy-two letters.
